## How to make any nonstick pan last longer

1. Cook on low to medium heat.
2. Avoid preheating an empty pan.
3. Use silicone or wooden utensils.
4. Hand-wash instead of using the dishwasher.
5. Avoid thermal shock (putting a hot pan under cold water).

One important thing: no conventional coated nonstick pan lasts forever. If you want cookware that can last 10–20+ years, carbon steel or cast iron is a better investment.
